crossRefs.note: A mighty king will stand up, who will rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
“The king will do according to his will. He will exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and will speak…
I saw the ram pushing westward, northward, and southward. No animals could stand before him. There wasn’t any who could…
I saw him come close to the ram, and he was moved with anger against him, and struck the ram, and broke his two horns.…
He will enter also into the glorious land, and many countries will be overthrown; but these will be delivered out of…
He will plant the tents of his palace between the sea and the glorious holy mountain; yet he will come to his end, and…
Out of one of them came out a little horn, which grew exceedingly great, toward the south, and toward the east, and…
It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through. It will reach even to the neck. The stretching out…
“But I said, ‘How I desire to put you among the children, and give you a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the armies…

translations.web: But he who comes against him will do according to his own will, and no one will stand before him. He will stand in the glorious land, and destruction will be in his hand.
translations.bsb: The invader will do as he pleases, and no one will stand against him. He will establish himself in the Beautiful Land, with destruction in his hand.
translations.kjv: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.
translations.asv: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him; and he shall stand in the glorious land, and in his hand shall be destruction.
